base_story_template.en: Welcome {{STUDENT_NAME}} to our learning session at the {{INTEREST_PLACE}}! Today we explore Role of the Government in Health. This lesson is key to mapping how inputs transform to outputs.

concept_explanation.en: In this chapter, we explore Role of the Government in Health in detail. This topic is essential for Grade 7 academic standards. We study the core principles, terminology, and real-world relevance.
concept_explanation.hi: इस अध्योय में हम स्वास्थ्य में सरकार की भूमिका का विस्तार से अध्ययन करते हैं॥
concept_explanation.kn: ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾವು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪಾತ್ರ ದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರವಾಗಿ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ಧೇವೆ.

en: Mastering Role of the Government in Health builds foundational academic knowledge.
Active problem solving helps retain concepts.
Pay close attention to key definitions.
